title: Production and Characterization of SARS-CoV-2 PLpro in Escherichia coli
author: De Falco, Greene-Cramer, et al.
materials:
Timing: 1 h
1.Prepare 50 mg mL−1 ampicillin stock:a.Weigh 2.5 g of ampicillin sodium salt (Sigma Aldrich).b.Dissolve using a 50% v/v ethanol solution to 50 mL.c.Sterilize using a 0.22 μm syringe filter and store at −20°C for up to 1 year.2.Prepare 1 M isopropyl-β-d-thiogalactopyranoside (IPTG):a.Weigh 2.38 g of IPTG (molar mass 238.30 g mol−1) (Sigma Aldrich).b.Dissolve in MilliQ water to a final volume of 10 mL and divide into 10 × 1 mL aliquots.c.Sterilize using a 0.22 μm syringe filter and store at −20°C for up to 1 year.3.Prepare 1 M dithiothreitol (DTT):a.Weigh 1.54 g of DTT (molar mass 154.25 g mol−1) (Sigma Aldrich).b.Dissolve in MilliQ water to a final volume of 10 mL and divide into 10 × 1 mL aliquots.c.Store at −20°C for up to 6 months.4.Prepare 1 M ZnCl2:a.Weigh 6.81 g of ZnCl2 (molar mass 136.286 g mol−1).b.Dissolve it in a final volume of 50 mL.c.Store at 4°C for up to 6 months.
Alternative: For the production of 19F-labeled-5-fluoro-L-Trp93 and Trp106 protein samples, prepare the additional stock solution:
5.Prepare 1 M 5-Fluoroindole:a.Weigh 3.38 g of 5-Fluoroindole (molar mass 135.14 g mol−1).b.Dissolve in DMSO to a final volume of 20 mL.c.Store in 0.5 mL aliquots at −20°C for up to 1 year.

Timing: 4 h
6.Prepare 1 L Lysogeny Broth (LB) medium:a.Dispense 1 L MilliQ water into 2800 mL culture flask (Wilmad-LabGlass SP Scienceware).b.Add 20 LB Broth capsules, 1 g each (Research Products International).c.Sterilize in autoclave (121°C, 15 psi, 20 min).7.Prepare 250 mL of LB-agar for bacterial cell culture plates:a.Dissolve 3.75 g of agar (Sigma Aldrich) using MilliQ water to 250 mL (agar will not completely dissolve until heating during autoclave sterilization – see next points).b.Add 5 LB Broth capsules, 1 g each (Research Products International).c.Sterilize in autoclave (121°C, 15 psi, 20 min).d.Allow the sterilized LB-agar mixture to cool down to ∼ 50°C.e.Add 500 μL of 50 mg mL−1 ampicillin stock solution.CRITICAL: Antibiotics must be added after the solution has cooled to ∼ 40°C to prevent thermal degradation.f.Under aseptic conditions, pour the LB-agar into Petri dishes.g.Allow the agar to solidify before sealing the plates with parafilm.h.Store the LB-agar plates upside down at 4°C, to prevent aqueous vapor condensation on the surface of the LB-Agar.

Timing: 1 h
8.For 15N (or 15N,13C) enriched protein samples production, prepare MJ9 minimal medium calculations refer to 1 L final volume)6:a.Weigh 6 g of K2HPO4 (J.T. Baker).b.Weigh 9 g of KH2PO4 (J.T. Baker).c.Weigh 1.5 g of (15NH4)2SO4 (Sigma Aldrich).d.Weigh 0.5 g of sodium citrate dihydrate (J.T. Baker).e.Weigh between 3 and 5 g of D-Glucose.Alternative: For experiments that require 13C isotopes, use carbon-labeled D-Glucose (U-13C6, 99%) (Sigma Aldrich, Cambridge Isotope).f.Dissolve the powder in a final volume of 1 L, adding MilliQ water.g.Adjust the pH to 6.8.h.Filter using a sterile filter.i.Add 1 mL of vitamin stock (MEM Vitamin Solution 100× – Sigma Aldrich M6895).j.Add 1 g of MgSO4 × 7H2O (J.T. Baker 2500-01).k.Add 1 mL of trace elements stock (1000×).l.Add 1 mL of stock ampicillin.

steps.title: Prepare reagent stock solutions
steps.instruction: Make all required stock solutions and store them as indicated.

substeps.instruction: Ampicillin 50 mg mL⁻¹: weigh 2.5 g ampicillin sodium salt, dissolve in 50 % v/v ethanol to 50 mL, filter (0.22 µm) and store at –20 °C (up to 1 yr).
IPTG 1 M: weigh 2.38 g IPTG, dissolve in Milli‑Q water to 10 mL, aliquot 1 mL portions, filter (0.22 µm) and store at –20 °C (up to 1 yr).
DTT 1 M: weigh 1.54 g DTT, dissolve in Milli‑Q water to 10 mL, aliquot 1 mL portions, store at –20 °C (up to 6 mo).
ZnCl₂ 1 M: weigh 6.81 g ZnCl₂, dissolve in 50 mL water, store at 4 °C (up to 6 mo).
5‑Fluoroindole 1 M (optional for 19F‑Trp labeling): weigh 3.38 g, dissolve in DMSO to 20 mL, aliquot 0.5 mL, store at –20 °C (up to 1 yr).

steps.title: Prepare LB broth and agar plates
steps.instruction: Prepare liquid LB medium for cultures and LB‑agar plates for selection.

substeps.instruction: LB broth (1 L): add 1 L Milli‑Q water to a 2.8 L flask, add 20 × 1 g LB broth capsules, autoclave (121 °C, 15 psi, 20 min).

LB‑agar (250 mL): dissolve 3.75 g agar in water, add 5 × 1 g LB broth capsules, autoclave (121 °C, 15 psi, 20 min). Cool to ~50 °C, add 500 µL ampicillin stock (50 mg mL⁻¹). Under aseptic conditions pour into Petri dishes, let solidify, seal with parafilm, store plates upside‑down at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare MJ9 minimal medium (optional isotopic)
steps.instruction: Make 1 L MJ9 minimal medium for 15N or 15N/13C labeling.

substeps.instruction: Weigh: 6 g K₂HPO₄, 9 g KH₂PO₄, 1.5 g (¹⁵NH₄)₂SO₄, 0.5 g sodium citrate dihydrate, 3–5 g D‑glucose (use U‑¹³C₆ glucose for 13C labeling).
Dissolve powders in water to 1 L, adjust pH to 6.8, filter sterile.
Add 1 mL MEM vitamin stock (100×), 1 g MgSO₄·7H₂O, 1 mL trace‑elements stock (1000×), and 1 mL ampicillin stock (50 mg mL⁻¹).

steps.title: Transform BL21(DE3) cells with plasmid
steps.instruction: Introduce the SUMO‑PLpro plasmid into chemically competent BL21(DE3) cells.

substeps.instruction: Thaw one vial of BL21(DE3) competent cells on ice.
Add 5–10 ng plasmid (1–5 µL) to the cells, tap to mix (do not pipette).
Incubate on ice 30 min.
Heat‑shock at 42 °C for exactly 30 s, then return to ice.
Add 250 µL pre‑warmed SOC medium, shake at 225 rpm, 37 °C for 1 h.
Plate 20–200 µL of the mixture on LB‑agar plates containing ampicillin, keep remaining mix at 4 °C.
Incubate plates inverted 12–18 h at 37 °C.

steps.title: Pick colonies and start starter culture
steps.instruction: Select individual transformants and grow an overnight starter.

substeps.instruction: Pick 3–4 single colonies (to account for expression variability).
Inoculate each colony into 50 mL LB broth with 100 µg mL⁻¹ ampicillin.
Incubate 16 h at 37 °C, 200 rpm.

steps.title: Scale up culture and induce expression
steps.instruction: Grow a large culture, monitor growth, and induce PLpro production.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 5–25 mL of the starter into 1 L LB broth containing 100 µg mL⁻¹ ampicillin.
Incubate at 37 °C, 200 rpm, measuring OD₆₀₀ every 30 min until ~0.6 (≈1.5–3 h).
Add IPTG to 1 mM and ZnCl₂ to 1 µM to induce expression.
Continue incubation 16–18 h at 17 °C, 200 rpm.
For isotopically labeled protein, use MJ9 minimal medium (add 50 µg mL⁻¹ ampicillin) and follow the same induction schedule.
For 19F‑Trp‑labeled protein, add one 0.5 mL aliquot of 5‑Fluoroindole stock together with IPTG and ZnCl₂.

steps.title: Harvest cells by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Collect bacterial cells from the expression culture.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the 1 L culture at 4 000 × g, 4 °C for 50 min.
Discard supernatant and keep the cell pellet on ice.

steps.title: Resuspend cells and lyse by sonication

substeps.instruction: Add 30 mL lysis buffer (composition as used for downstream IMAC) to the pellet.
Add 1 µL nuclease mix (25–29 U µL⁻¹) and gently resuspend.
Lyse cells using a micro‑tip sonicator (e.g., Misonix S‑4000) on ice (pulse settings as appropriate).

steps.title: Clarify lysate and prepare for IMAC
steps.instruction: Remove debris and keep soluble extract for affinity purification.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the sonicated suspension at 15 000 × g, 4 °C for 30 min.
Collect the supernatant (soluble extract) and keep on ice.

steps.title: IMAC purification and collect flowthrough
steps.instruction: Purify PLpro using Ni²⁺ affinity chromatography and collect the tag‑free protein.

substeps.instruction: Wash a 5 mL HisTrap HP column with 5 column volumes (CV) Milli‑Q water.
Equilibrate the column with 5 CV loading/washing buffer.
Load the soluble extract onto the column using loading/washing buffer; collect the flowthrough (contains native PLpro).
Wash the column with loading/washing buffer while monitoring A₂₈₀; keep flowthrough fractions at 4 °C.
Take a 15 µL aliquot of flowthrough for SDS‑PAGE analysis.
Elute bound His‑tagged proteins with 5 CV 100 % elution buffer (higher imidazole); collect fractions until A₂₈₀ baseline returns to zero.
Take a 15 µL aliquot of the elution pool for SDS‑PAGE.
Add 4× Sample Loading Buffer to each fraction (5 µL buffer per 5 µL sample).
Boil samples 5 min at 90 °C.
Load 5–7 µL of each sample plus a molecular weight ladder on a gel and run.
Store samples at –20 °C until all fractions are collected.

steps.title: Concentrate protein before SEC
steps.instruction: Reduce volume of PLpro solution to 2–5 mL for size‑exclusion chromatography.

substeps.instruction: Use a Sartorius Vivaspin PES concentrator (MWCO 10 kDa) to concentrate to 2–5 mL.
Monitor concentration by A₂₈₀ (ε₂₈₀ = 45 270 M⁻¹ cm⁻¹); keep ≤0.2 mM to avoid precipitation.
If >0.2 mM, split the sample into multiple aliquots and concentrate each separately.

steps.title: Size exclusion chromatography purification
steps.instruction: Perform SEC to obtain monodisperse PLpro.

substeps.instruction: Wash SEC column (HiLoad 16/600 Superdex 75 pg) with 1 CV Milli‑Q water.
Equilibrate with ≥1.35 CV SEC buffer (buffer composition as used for storage).
Load up to 5 mL of concentrated protein using an appropriate sample loop; run at ≤0.8 mL min⁻¹ at 4 °C.
Collect eluate in 2 mL fractions; take a 15 µL aliquot from each fraction for SDS‑PAGE.
Analyze fractions as in the SDS‑PAGE step (add loading buffer, boil, run).

steps.title: Finalize protein concentration, aliquot, and store
steps.instruction: Concentrate purified PLpro to final working concentrations, aliquot, flash‑freeze, and store.

substeps.instruction: Concentrate native PLpro up to 6.5 mg mL⁻¹ (≈0.14 mM).
Aliquot 50–100 µL for standard use; for 19F‑Trp‑labeled protein concentrate to 200 µM and aliquot 100–270 µL; for 15N‑labeled protein concentrate to 150 µM and aliquot 270 µL.
Flash‑freeze aliquots in liquid nitrogen and store at –80 °C (up to 6 months).
Note: alternative storage buffers compatible with downstream assays may be used.
